component_checklist.assertion: On first open the register dialog shows one required combobox, two textboxes, and one small ghost collapse. There is no spinbutton, no unit, no checkbox, and no alert. Source is empty and its placeholder is the localized select-a-repository sentence. Source ID is an empty required textbox of type text. Its placeholder is Qwen/Qwen3-8B and it has no maximum length. Name is an empty textbox of type text, is not marked required, has no maximum length, and its placeholder is the localized optional display name. The collapse header is the localized advanced-options sentence, aria-expanded is false, and revision is not visible. Directory URL, model directory, node, model ID, and parse are absent. After Hugging Face is selected the combobox text is Hugging Face, and source ID, name, and the collapsed revision stay unchanged. The same run rejects a 257-character name with status 400 and stores no model. That rejected POST body is source huggingface, the fixture repository, the fixture commit, the 257-character name, the fixture readme, the fixture config, the fixture weight, an empty logo, and browser metadata. The corrected POST 201 changes only the name to the typed name. The independent GET stores source huggingface, the fixture repository, the fixture commit, the typed name, Qwen2ForCausalLM, float16, context length 4096, the fixture readme, the fixture weight, and no node copy and no storage copy.
